justification: Standard: adds guards to two scripts that write production tables. Not Critical: no change to what is written when the guards pass, and nothing served changes. Not Minor: it changes when production writes happen.

pre_impl.existing_data: procedural_guidance 46, application_checklists 158, getting_started_guides 5 rows (RLS on); ku_ring_gai current provisions 6042. Read via read-only role.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The checklist file has 12 entries but writes 158 rows (items per checklist), so the shrink guard counts items, not entries.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Guards added inside the existing scripts. The only shared backup helper (load_greenweb_overlay.backup_existing) is tied to spatial_overlays.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A missing, truncated or non-list JSON export now aborts before any connection.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: an empty export file emptied the procedural guidance tables served to users. Now: abort with nothing written.

falsifiable_check.observed_red: With origin/main's KRG script: 2 failed (test_import_does_not_connect, test_dry_run_reads_but_never_updates). This branch: 13 passed. Live dry run with read-only role: 46/158/5 rows now and after, nothing written.
